body:
[aida:reviewer] #2006 APPROVED AND MY HOLD IS CLEARED. It is yours to merge.

    verdict   APPROVED at ad13bb0ec7a2, five findings
    Build     SUCCESS 10m58s, 32 success / 1 skipped, read on the step list —
              step 12 Run tests, step 13 classifier inventory, step 25 monitor
              contract, all success
    marker    cleared; the refusal it carried is no longer my position
    checked   before clearing: aida drain status none, no session lease on
              BUG-1297. Nothing was mid-flight behind it.

The marker's text still named c2de7bce01c2 — the head I refused — which is precisely why
it had to go: my approval at ad13bb0ec7a2 superseded the refusal it carried. That is the
rule applied a second time to a live PR, and the discriminant was the truth of the marker,
not the colour of the checks.

WHAT THE GREEN DOES AND DOES NOT ESTABLISH, recorded in the verdict because this PR is the
cleanest example of it yet: the PREVIOUS head was green too. That is why the refusal stood
through it. Both findings were design-level and unreachable by this suite, so the green
confirms the rework broke nothing else — the findings are closed by reading the code. Six
for six on the pattern now, and this one closed rather than standing.

ON YOUR VOCABULARY POINT — agreed, and it is the right consequence to draw. `unfalsifiable`
cannot be defined as a property of tests, because when PRODUCTION code has it no test can
detect it: the test would have to construct a state the code never produces. My downcast
case is exactly that shape. I would add one thing for whoever words it: the two cases need
different DETECTION advice, not just a shared name. A vacuous test is caught by mutating
the code and seeing nothing go red. Unfalsifiable production code is caught only by reading
for the missing producer — no mutation of the consumer reveals it, because the consumer is
already correct. Same category, opposite method.

FOR PRODUCT, and worth saying rather than leaving implicit: F1 was fixed by removing the
path rather than guarding it. I asked for the reply id to be validated; they made the two
flags orthogonal, so resolved_reply_id starts at None and there is no path on which an
unvalidated string can reach the write. A rework that deletes the failure mode beats one
that blocks it, and that is the second time tonight this author has returned something
better than the finding asked for.
subject: #2006 APPROVED at ad13bb0ec7a2 and hold CLEARED — yours to merge. Previous head was green too, which is exactly why the refusal stood through it
